'''Hurd''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as part of the [[Mantellian Army|Mantellian army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during part of the war, where he fought against the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] in the [[Separatist War]].

==Biography==
Hurd was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Mantellian Army|Mantellian army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the Republic. During the war he held the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] and was deployed on the Republic held [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="EGPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>. While stationed on the planet he and all Republic forces aided the corrupt local government in fighting the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]].<ref name="TOR" />

While stationed on Ord Mantell Hurd worked out of [[Fort Garnik]], a Republic stronghold on the planet. During his time stationed at Garnik the [[Republic trooper]]s under Hurd's control were responsible for guarding the Fort's medical supplies. While guarding the supplies one of Hurd's soldiers fell asleep at his post and a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] named [[Yael]], who was living in the refugee camp outside of Garnik at the time, saw an opportunity to take the supplies to help her fellow refugees. The guard awoke just in time to see the thief escape but managed to identify her gender and [[Species/Legends|species]] to Hurd.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Hurd then asked a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound|Ace]] and a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|member]] of [[Havoc Squad]] whom he encountered in Garnik to retrieve the medicine for him claiming that good men were dying without it. The pair using the guard's description of the thief tracked her down to the refugee camp and confronted her about the supplies. The Cathar admitted she'd taken them but said she no longer had them as Separatists had stolen them and taken them to [[Talloran village]]. The smuggler and trooper then managed to retrieve the supplies but chose to give the back to Yael to help the refugees instead of giving them to Hurd<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
While at Fort Garnik Hurd wore [[blue]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with four ammo pockets on the chest and a pair of beige pants with knee [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hurd is a non-player character from the massively multiplayer online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. Hurd is involved in the quest 'Mercy' in which players can chose to either give retrieved medical supplies to him or [[Yael]], with giving the supplies to him being a dark side choice meaning this articles assumes players followed the light side choice and gave the supplies to Yael. Choosing the dark side option will result in the same reward being given to the player by Hurd being either [[Drelliad boots]] to smugglers or hardened plastifold boots to troopers. It is not possible for players of the Imperial faction to interact with Hurd as there is currently no way Imperial characters can travel to Ord Mantell.<ref name="TOR" />
